question: What supreme benefit is declared for the practice of the blue-bodied goddess?
premises: The subject is the blue-bodied goddess.
A supreme declaration is made concerning her.
The declared result is the granting of all-purpose accomplishment.
inference: The supreme practice of the blue-bodied goddess is declared to grant accomplishment of all aims.
plain_english: The supreme teaching concerning the blue-bodied goddess is declared to grant the accomplishment of all purposes.
